title: La Leyenda Pirata — Gauntlet Loop
goal: Mobile Three.js pirate game (island builder + open-sea sailing + raids) built from the CC0 Pirate Nation voxel assets.
bar: Official Pirate Nation media — the shipped game made from these exact assets. Our screenshots must win a blind side-by-side against it.

pieces.name: Asset pipeline
pieces.bar: Every model loads at a sane size with its animation clips intact, under 300KB.

rounds.summary: 36 models fetched from the CC0 library and optimized to .glb (9.5MB total, animations preserved). Models rendered at wildly wrong scales.
rounds.gap: Model normalization is broken: three.js, the glTF node transforms, and the GPU disagree about how big a skinned model is — the foundry rendered ~200 units instead of 5.

rounds.summary: Root cause found and split in two: gltf-transform's flatten/join double-applied armature transforms on skinned models, and no analytical method measures these models correctly. Pipeline now skips flatten/join for skinned documents, and sizes are calibrated from rendered pixels.
Terrain, stepped beach/grass plateaus, sand paths and the voxel water shader render correctly. Buildings blocked on the scale bug.
rounds.gap: Water reads too dark and too uniformly blue; foam is evenly scattered where the reference clusters it near the shore. No buildings visible yet.

pieces.name: Economy and save
pieces.bar: A session can be played, closed and resumed with offline production applied.
